Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jq && grep -n "decNumberCompare(&res" -n src/jv.c && sed -n '1,120p' src/jv.c | head -40 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"attacker input","code":"A JSON number literal is supplied to jq","note":"The attacker controls the numeric text that jq parses into a decNumber-backed value."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lexer.c","function":"yylex","line":1369,"var":"yylval->literal","code":"yylval->literal = jv_parse_sized(yytext, yyleng);","note":"The lexer hands the raw numeric token to the JSON parser, preserving the attacker-controlled digits and exponent."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/jv_parse.c","function":"jv_parse_sized","line":862,"var":"jv number literal","code":"jv_parse_sized(string, length)","note":"The parser converts the token into a jq number value, which can retain a decNumber representation for literals."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/jv.c","function":"jvp_number_cmp","line":758,"var":"decNumber res","code":"decNumberCompare(&res, jvp_dec_number_ptr(a), jvp_dec_number_ptr(b), DEC_CONTEXT());","note":"When two literal numbers are compared, jq dispatches to decNumberCompare on the attacker-controlled operands."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/decNumber/decNumber.c","function":"decCompare","line":6220,"var":"rhs->exponent - lhs->exponent","code":"compare = decUnitCompare(lhs->lsu, D2U(lhs->digits), rhs->lsu, D2U(rhs->digits), rhs->exponent-lhs->exponent);","note":"The comparison computes an exponent difference without bounding the digit count, so extreme adjusted exponents can overflow the 32-bit subtraction used to derive the shift."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/decNumber/decNumber.c","function":"decUnitCompare","line":6258,"var":"exp","code":"if (alength>blength+(Int)D2U(exp)) return 1;","note":"The overflowed exponent difference is consumed as a shift amount in the unit comparison, creating the memory-safety sink through miscomputed bounds and subtraction logic."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p.read_text())
PY
